Date: Thu, 30 Jul 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Embedded agent: lightweight telemetry + marketplace playbook

Hi Priyom —

Thanks again for taking the call today. As discussed, Observify has a lightweight agent (C binary + small Go shim) that can run on inference hosts to capture per-request latencies, sample traces, and fine-grained GPU metrics without impacting tail latency. We think a packaged integration + a Redwood marketplace listing would be a quick win for both engineering teams and customers looking for richer observability on low-latency LLM deployments.

Quick ask: can you share Redwood's technical requirements for packaged agents (sec review checklist, supported runtimes, allowed network egress rules) and the go/no-go criteria for marketplace inclusion? We can prototype a sandbox build in ~3 weeks if we have the acceptance checklist.

Attachment: observify-light-agent-arch.png (arch diagram)

Best,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product Partnerships, Observify
samir@observify.com
From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Samir Patel <samir@observify.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedded agent: lightweight telemetry + marketplace playbook

Samir —

Really appreciate the follow-up and the diagram. High level: Redwood supports partner-delivered agents but we require a short security questionnaire + a signed SOW for any agent that runs on customer-dedicated or private infrastructure. For marketplace listings we additionally require:

- Binary provenance (sha256), build reproducibility notes
- Minimal privileges (drop to non-root where possible)
- No outgoing traffic without explicit allowlist; telemetry must use our routing agent or a vetted endpoint
- A 2-week soak test plan in our sandbox with representative LLM workloads

Ben + Laura — can you advise on commercial packaging and the usual timeline for publishing a marketplace tile? Also looping platform owners for any runtime constraints.

Attachments: sow_observify_redwood_v1.docx

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Embedded agent: lightweight telemetry + marketplace playbook

Hey team —

This looks promising. Marketplace checklist and process below (summary):

1) Commercial: pricing SKU (metered/flat), lead capture, free trial credits — typically a 30–45 day GTM prep.
2) Legal/Compliance: templated MSA + SOW; need SOC2 or equivalent for agent handling telemetry.
3) Technical: an install bundle (deb/rpm/docker) + clear uninstall; sandbox soak for 10–14 days; automated health probes.
4) Support: a named technical contact and an escalation path for cross-account issues.

Suggested go-forward: Observify provides a sandbox build by Aug 14; Redwood will run soak in our staging pool Aug 17–28; marketplace listing prep Aug 30–Sep 15. If Observify is fine with a simple revenue-share listing, I can draft the commercial bullet points.

Laura — if we agree to the timeline I'll start the HubSpot deal and attach the standard rev-share template. Samir — can you confirm SOC2 status and the expected agent memory/CPU footprint at 8k token sequences?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference

Thanks Ben —

SOC2 Type II: in flight, expected report by Nov 2026; we have attestations for secure build pipelines and signed SBOMs for the agent. Memory/CPU: our Go shim typical baseline is ~45MB RSS and it adds ~8% CPU under 8k token infer requests (measured on a T4-like profile); we will include more rigorous numbers in the sandbox build.

We can target Aug 14 for the sandbox artifact if Redwood can provide the staging image with the test harness. Also attached a compact checklist we use for marketplace onboarding.

Attachments: marketplace-listing-checklist.xlsx

Best,
Samir
